listing.name: Nyan Cat Mod
listing.summary: This mod adds the Nyan Cat Faction to the campaign, they spawn the first day on the far left of the map and they help you attacking the pirates (this can change if you think it's better otherwise) for now there is only one ship, the normal Nyan Cat and one tipe of fleet, the scout.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction that spawns on the far left of the map and assists in attacking pirates.

description:
version 0.1 http://www.mediafire.com/?b6j5x65a22s114x

hi folks here's my first mod ;D
This mod adds the Nyan Cat Faction to the campaign, they spawn the first day on the far left of the map and they help you attacking the pirates (this can change if you think it's better otherwise)
for now there is only one ship, the normal Nyan Cat and one tipe of fleet, the scout.
I plan on adding bigger fleets, custom music and sounds, more ships like a "mothership" and different types of  nyan cat. It's also possible a future change to something more diverse like a meme mod where the nyan cat it's only the scout unit

so for now this ship is a small capital ship incredibly overpowered, yet alone so it can be beaten by a large fleet
it's armed with laser shooting eyes and close range poptarts turret

btw I asked if there is any problem for an eventual copyright and there is no problem for the author (after all it's a meme and eveybody uses it)

so sorry for the bad english and please leave feedback and why not, if you want to help me I appreciate because I'm not a real modder, I just started  ;D

ciao belli,
Argi25

aiDescription: Introduces a new faction featuring a single small capital ship, the Nyan Cat, which is described as incredibly overpowered but beatable by large fleets. The ship is armed with laser shooting eyes and close range poptarts turrets. Currently, only one type of fleet, the scout, is available.
